_doc: Your expected mount set. On boot, DIFF what is actually mounted against 'expected' (an allowlist). ANYTHING mounted that is not in 'expected' is foreign -- STOP and flag it; do not read it into context (anti-drift C1). A required mount missing -- STOP and ask the user to add it. Applies only when this project runs in its own task. If the workspace root is mounted (Prime's seat: solo start, or the coordinator), this check is dormant -- see this project's CLAUDE.md.
